description: ContributesTo edge cases: an object (non-interface) declaration is rejected like an abstract class; a nested public interface is contributable and reported in dotted form for both the outer and inner inspect targets; and two non-public contributions in different packages collapse to a single deduplicated reason line.

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=Only interfaces can be contributed.

status=compiled
contribution origin=com.nest.Outer
extends com.nest.Outer
contribution origin=com.nest.Outer.Inner
extends com.nest.Outer.Inner

sources:
package com.one

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesTo

@ContributesTo(Unit::class)
private interface First
package com.two

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesTo

@ContributesTo(Unit::class)
private interface Second

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=Contributed component interfaces must be public.
